rootCause: Artifact Registry cleanup policy 'firebase-functions-cleanup' (Firebase default: DELETE olderThan 86400s tagState ANY) deletes every function image older than 24h. burnbar gcf-artifacts measured 0.000MB. Deploy lane blocked since 09-14/09-16 meant no fresh images for 9 days, so every previous revision lost its image. Ready=True/Retired is the last-known state, not a pull guarantee.
